ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows rectangle ABCD with A at the lower left, B at the lower right, C at the upper right, and D at the upper left. The two drawn segments AC and BD are the diagonals of the rectangle. Reasoning: In a rectangle, the diagonals are congruent, so AC = BD. Given AC = 30 - x and BD = 4x - 60, set 30 - x = 4x - 60. Add x to both sides: 30 = 5x - 60. Add 60 to both sides: 90 = 5x. Divide by 5: x = 18.

method.method_draft: Read from the diagram that A and C are opposite corners and B and D are the other opposite corners of the same rectangle. Model the rectangle with side lengths w and h. Then AC is the hypotenuse of a right triangle with legs w and h, and BD is also the hypotenuse of a congruent right triangle with the same legs w and h. Thus AC=sqrt(w^2+h^2) and BD=sqrt(w^2+h^2), so AC=BD. Substitute the text-given expressions 30-x and 4x-60, then solve 30-x=4x-60 to get x=18.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中 ABCD 是一个矩形，A 在左下角，B 在右下角，C 在右上角，D 在左上角；线段 AC 和 BD 都是矩形的对角线。
推理：设矩形的长和宽分别为 w 和 h。对角线 AC 是以 w、h 为直角边的直角三角形的斜边，所以 AC = sqrt(w^2+h^2)。对角线 BD 也是同一个矩形中以 w、h 为直角边的直角三角形的斜边，所以 BD = sqrt(w^2+h^2)。因此矩形两条对角线相等，即 AC = BD。代入题目给出的 AC=30-x 和 BD=4x-60，得到 30-x = 4x-60。解得 90 = 5x，所以 x = 18。
